description: This file defines the abstract base class `BaseOpenmrsObject` which implements core functionality for OpenMRS objects, such as UUID handling, equality, hashcode, and string representation.

classes.name: BaseOpenmrsObject
classes.description: An abstract class providing UUID management, equality, hashing, and string representation functionalities for OpenMRS domain objects.

methods.name: getUuid
methods.description: Returns the UUID of the object.

methods.name: setUuid
methods.description: Sets the UUID of the object.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes the hash code based on the UUID, or delegates to super if UUID is null.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Determines equality based on UUID, considering object identity, class type, and UUID match.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation including class name, hash code, and UUID.
